quotes.speaker: Myron Gardner

quotes.excerpt: There's more attention to detail, there's more buying into the culture.

quotes.speaker: Myron Gardner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myron Gardner on Giannis Antetokounmpo's impact without the ball
quotes.excerpt: He got a lot of gravity to him, so he make the game for us easier.
quotes.quote: A lot of impact, just him rolling, rim running to the board, rim running, and getting offensive rebounds. He got a lot of gravity to him, so he make the game for us easier.
quotes.social_post: Myron Gardner on Giannis Antetokounmpo: He has a lot of gravity to him and he makes the game easier for everyone else.

quotes.speaker: Myron Gardner
